llmnr.description: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution mode: 'yes', 'no', or 'resolve'

accept_rdnss.description: Whether to accept Router Advertisement DNS (RDNSS) information

emit_dns.description: Whether to emit DNS resolver info to /etc/resolv.conf (systemd-resolved)

max_dns_servers.description: Maximum number of DNS servers to store in /etc/resolv.conf (0 = all)

max_ntp_servers.description: Maximum number of NTP servers to store (0 = all)

default_route.description: Whether to use default routes for DNS/LLMNR/mDNS traffic

ipv6_route_priority.description: Offset for IPv6 route priority; negative values increase priority

link_local_addressing.description: Link-local address generation mode: 'yes' (IPv4LL + IPv6SL), 'both', or 'no'

ipv6_hop_limit.description: Hop limit for IPv6 router announcements (0 = default)

mtu_bytes.description: Override default interface MTU (0 = use default)

max_routes.description: Maximum number of routes per interface (0 = no limit)

carry_over_mac.description: Whether to preserve MAC addresses across restarts

dhcp.description: DHCP mode: 'yes' (IPv4+IPv6), 'no', 'ipv4', 'ipv6', or 'ipv6' (IPv4 only if no IPv6)

send_hostname.description: Whether to send the local hostname to DHCP servers

send_vendor_class.description: Whether to send vendor class identifier to DHCP servers

request_options.description: Comma-separated list of DHCP options to request (e.g., '1,3,6')

emit_ntp.description: Whether to emit NTP servers to /etc/resolv.conf

emit_router.description: Whether to emit router info (RA) to /etc/resolv.conf

emit_timezone.description: Whether to emit timezone info to /etc/resolv.conf

use_ntp.description: Whether to use NTP servers received via DHCP

use_dns.description: Whether to use DNS servers received via DHCP

use_domains.description: Whether to use domain search lists received via DHCP

use_timezone.description: Whether to use time zone received via DHCP

link_mac.description: MAC address to assign to matched interfaces (empty = use default)

link_mtu.description: MTU for matched interfaces (0 = use default)

link_name.description: Interface name to assign for matched devices (e.g., 'lan0')

dhcpv4_default_route.description: Whether to use default route from DHCPv4

dhcpv4_use_ntp.description: Whether to use NTP servers from DHCPv4

dhcpv4_use_dns.description: Whether to use DNS servers from DHCPv4

dhcpv4_use_domains.description: Whether to use domain search from DHCPv4

dhcpv4_use_timezone.description: Whether to use time zone from DHCPv4

dhcpv6_use_address.description: Whether to use IPv6 address from DHCPv6

dhcpv6_use_prefix.description: Whether to use IPv6 prefix from DHCPv6

dhcpv6_use_dns.description: Whether to use DNS servers from DHCPv6

dhcpv6_use_ntp.description: Whether to use NTP servers from DHCPv6

dhcpv6_use_domains.description: Whether to use domain search from DHCPv6

ipv6_accept_ra_enabled.description: Whether to accept IPv6 Router Advertisements (global)

ipv6_accept_ra_use_address.description: Whether to configure addresses from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_default_route.description: Whether to configure default routes from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_use_dns.description: Whether to configure DNS from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_use_mtu.description: Whether to configure MTU from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_use_ntp.description: Whether to configure NTP from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_use_domains.description: Whether to configure domain search from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_use_hop_limit.description: Whether to configure hop limit from Router Advertisements

ipv6_accept_ra_route_table.description: Route table ID for Router Advertisement routes (0 = main)

ipv6_accept_ra_route_metric.description: Route metric for Router Advertisement routes (0 = default)
